bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · back above the 100-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 重回 100 日均线上方

read.en: Nvidia rose 2.4% on Oct 26 to $216.00, trading between $212.61 and $217.75. It is above the falling 5-day ($215.5) and 100-day ($214.4) and the rising 200-day ($203.8) averages, and below the falling 10-day ($217.6) and 30-day ($224.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($228.63), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月26日上涨 2.4%，收于 $216.00，盘中区间 $212.61–217.75。股价位于下行的 5 日（$215.5）和 100 日均线（$214.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$203.8）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$217.6）和 30 日均线（$224.2）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$228.63），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $211.3–214.4 resistance (Oct 22 low, 100-day), now support; the $217.75 high stopped at the 10-day. Resistance is $217.6–218.9 (10-day, Oct 22 high), then $222.2 (Oct 21 high) and $224.2 (30-day). Support is $214.4–215.5 (100 and 5-day), then $210.2–211.3 (Oct 22–23 lows) and $207.3–208.9. A close above $218.9 would target $222–224; a close below $210.2 would open $207–209.
